summary.text: Chris Mann is the Democratic nominee for Attorney General and Kobach's 2022 opponent. A Lawrence attorney, he was a police officer until a drunk driver struck him during a 2002 traffic stop, then a Wyandotte County prosecutor and a Kansas Securities Commission attorney.

paragraphs.text: Became a police officer at 21; was struck by a drunk driver during a traffic stop in 2002, ending his law-enforcement career.

Attended Washburn University School of Law on a Koch Public Service Scholarship, then was an Assistant District Attorney in Wyandotte County and a Senior Staff Attorney at the Kansas Securities Commission.
Runs a private practice representing victims of drunk-driving crashes.
